attacks.name: Spider Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the Defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Fingertip Spinnerets
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

attacks.name: The Spectacular Spinning Jenny
steps: After each attack is resolved, the defender is Pushed Toward this character |!movement_small|.
After all attacks generated by this attack have been resolved, Place this character within |!range| 3 of itself.

superPowers.name: Caught in the Web
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a movement within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. The enemy character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| result rolled. Then, if this superpower dealt 1 |!damage| or more, this character may Advance |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Silk Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Web of the Bride
superPowers.body: When an enemy character with the |§slow§Slow| special condition ends a movement within |!range| 3 of this character, this character gains 1 |!power|.
